name: HeidelbergCement India Limited

annual_report.business: HeidelbergCement India Limited manufactures and sells cement, operating as a subsidiary of Heidelberg Materials Group.

capacity_or_capex.item: Dust Collector System at Imlai Cement Grinding Plant
Alternate Fuels Project at Narsingarh clinker plant
Cement Blending and Grinding Unit at Sri Singhaji Thermal Power Plant, Dongalia, Khandwa

guidance_or_targets.statement: Target of approximately 1.5 Mn tonnes of fly-ash sourcing for FY27

key_risks: Economic Risk: Global conflicts, Middle East trade exposure, rupee depreciation

Competition Risk: Increased competition in core markets challenging market share

With increase in input prices, will try to pass on the same to customers
FY27 EBITDA per ton expected to face INR100-160/t cost increase, confident of passing it on
Central India cement demand expected to grow 7-7.5% in FY27
Company volume growth to track industry growth in Central India
